implementation.clock: monotonic integer nanoseconds; active phase evaluated at exact configured boundaries
implementation.stage_identity: idempotent requests, expected-stage compare, never-reused generated IDs
implementation.stage_authority: derived from ACTIVE, no event hold, valid state and completed reset/epoch barriers

resource_bounds.request_idempotency_records: explicit profile cap; new requests fail closed when full
resource_bounds.event_records_per_stage: explicit profile cap; overflow event is rejected
resource_bounds.audit_journal: bounded profile-sized in-memory tail with monotonic sequence and observable dropped-record counter

semantic_zone.permission_window: explicit immutable StageProfile field bounded by freeze duration

event_adjudication.estimate_effect: local active-stage hold only; no official terminal result
event_adjudication.official_event_order: closed evidence intervals, independent of arrival order
event_adjudication.deadline: event upper bound must be strictly less than stage deadline
event_adjudication.capture_or_arrival_geometry: not inferred by StageManager; supplied by validated evidence producer

epoch_change.localization: invalidates estimate holds and requires action, plan, candidate, track, map and world acknowledgements
epoch_change.clock: new stage ID, clears stage/zone/event state and requires reset acknowledgements

implementation.audit: ordered in-memory request/transition/event journal preserving intervals, provenance IDs, evidence class and config/profile identity; bounded retention is explicit

verification.repository_regression_command: $env:PYTHONPATH = 'hsl_core;ros_ws\src\hsl_safety'; python -m pytest hsl_core\tests sim\kinematic ros_ws\src\hsl_interfaces\test ros_ws\src\hsl_safety\test -q

limitations: Pure-core tests do not validate ROS/DDS delivery, QoS, service authentication or process failure recovery.
The organizer authorization registry is supplied as immutable profile data; external credential verification belongs to the ROS adapter/deployment boundary.
Position error bound is preserved and validated but polygon offset/footprint contact must be computed by the separately tested geometry/referee layer.
The in-memory audit journal is bounded and reports dropped-record count; runtime must persist/forward records off the control path before the configured cap is reached.
No G0/G2/G3 physical acceptance or G4 end-to-end rehearsal is claimed.
